The data comes from Civiqs' rolling online tracking poll of registered voters. A Newsweek analysis compares Trump's approval rating on September 4, 2026, with where it stood when he returned to office on January 20, 2025, using net approval calculated as approve minus disapprove.

Nationally, Trump stands at 34 percent approval and 60 percent disapproval, giving him a net approval rating of minus 26.

#### Read More on Politics [...] Every state in the tracker now has a lower net approval rating than it did on January 20, 2025.

# September 2026 approval polls for Trump continue to wane in U.S., NC

Portrait of Iris Seaton Iris Seaton

Asheville Citizen Times

Sept. 8, 2026, 2:40 p.m. ET

 Recent national polls show President Donald Trump's approval rating has dropped, with some as low as 30%.
 A High Point University poll found Trump's approval rating among North Carolina registered voters is 42%.
